en-US.author: Windscribe Limited
en-US.description: Windscribe encrypts your browsing activity, blocks ads, and unblocks entertainment content
en-US.name: Windscribe
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added
- Optional detailed app and helper debug tracing on Windows to help pinpoint launch and connection delays.
Improved
- App hardening from the OpenAI Daybreak Blue and Anthropic Defense Access audit.
  - Security of WireGuard config handling on Windows.
  - Security of the Windows installer and uninstaller.
  - Security of in-app update staging on Windows.
  - Security of the OpenVPN DNS scripts on macOS and Linux.
  - Security of in-app update staging and installation on Linux.
- Security by running the OpenVPN daemon unelevated on Windows.
- Security of the OpenVPN daemon on macOS and Linux.
- Security by redacting VPN server credentials in debug logs.
- Split tunneling app selection duplicate detection on Windows and macOS.
- Hosts file handling for IKEv2 connections, so the app now retries when another program has the file locked on Windows.
- App only allows one running instance per machine. If another signed-in user is already running it, the app now explains why.
- Implementation of post-connect tunnel validation and connected IP state.
- Window installer to use libarchive rather than bundled 7z executable for extraction.
- App removes servers from the locations list with the force_disconnect flag set.
- Windows installer to return specific Windows error codes when a failure occurs.
- Split tunneling compatibility with other WFP redirectors to address potential system crashes on Windows.
- macOS Service-account creation and validation, including handling user ID conflicts and reporting creation failures.
- Custom Connected DNS to support scheme-prefixed DoT endpoints, including an explicit default port.
- Custom Connected DNS handling to avoid starting ctrld for a plain-IP upstream when Split DNS has no domains configured.
- windscribe-cli help to use a conventional layout with an aligned command list and per-command help, and made command output consistent.
- windscribe-cli help and documentation to explain how to turn on AmneziaWG with Protocol Tweaks. The app now logs a warning when the configured AmneziaWG preset is not available and it falls back to another preset.
- windscribe-cli locations commands to list locations in the terminal instead of opening the locations list in the app.
- windscribe-cli commands to report the app's actual result instead of only confirming the request was sent.
- windscribe-cli error messages for connection and update failures, so they describe the actual problem instead of showing a numeric error code.
Fixed
- Local privilege escalation vulnerability involving custom OpenVPN config parsing on Linux.
- OpenVPN-based protocols failing to connect on PCs where Windows cannot rename network adapters with netsh.
- OpenVPN connections failing on some Windows 11 insider builds because the app could not detect the management port.
- Potential app crash when connecting with a custom OpenVPN config on macOS.
- Custom Connected DNS failing after connection or location changes while the app showed Connected on Linux.
- Anti-censorship check not detecting a Chinese system language.
- App rewriting its whole settings file about once a minute while connected, even when nothing changed.
- Windows installer displaying error dialogs when -silent is specified on the command-line.
- ctrld being restarted before its previous instance had exited on macOS.
- ctrld daemon may fail to launch when Connected DNS preference is Control D on Windows.
- Windows tapctl.exe utility to always match OpenVPN version.
- Auto-Connect not triggering when a Hyper-V virtual adapter is the active network interface on Windows.
- AmneziaWG connections never completing when the config contains large I1-I5 packets on Windows.
- IKEv2 connections repeatedly showing a false "Read-Only File" hosts file prompt on Windows.
- Split tunneled traffic being blocked by the firewall on a secondary network interface on macOS.
- Split tunneled IPs going out through the primary interface instead of their original interface on Linux.
- A potential split tunneling extension crash caused by unsynchronized connection-table updates on macOS.
- Proxy Gateway retaining silent, unauthenticated connections without connection limits or a handshake timeout. Reported by Souparna Majumder.
- Network name and per-network settings remaining stale after waking on a different network through the same adapter on Windows.
- Installer starting the previous uninstaller before the helper service has finished stopping on Windows.
- Potential IKEv2 reconnect loop when asynchronous RAS disconnect notification fails to register with Windows.
- Menu bar icon not opening the app while another application is full screen on macOS.
- CLI-only Linux app ignoring the Launch on Startup preference when disabled.
- MTU detection and hotspot adapter detection failing with non-English system locales on Linux.
- systemd-resolved detection for additional resolv.conf symlink targets and stub-resolver configurations.
- Intentional ctrld shutdowns being logged as crashes.
- CLI from the GUI package fails on a headless environment with a no-display error.
- Split Tunneling Apps list accepting duplicate entries for manually added apps. Existing duplicates are now removed on load.
- MAC Spoofing turning off and its interface resetting to "No Interface" after suspend/resume or a NetworkManager restart on Linux.
- windscribe-cli login waiting forever when the login was abandoned, for example by closing the CAPTCHA, or when an email address was entered as the username.
- windscribe-cli help --help and version --help not showing help, and version accepting unexpected arguments.
- windscribe-cli logs send command reporting success before the upload finished, which hid upload failures.
- windscribe-cli log output appears in stdout on macOS and Linux.
- Declining the permission prompt during an in-app update showing an "Auto-Update Failed" error. The update window now returns to its prompt so the update can be started again.
- A missing space between the two sentences of the Decoy Traffic description in Preferences > Connection.
- Excluded apps' traffic, including IPv6 on dual-stack networks, going through the tunnel in Exclusive split tunneling mode on Windows.
- App not stopping an unresponsive WireGuard process after a disconnect timeout on macOS and Linux.
Updated
- The embedded API certificate bundle so it no longer trusts the compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates.
- Qt to 6.12.0.
- AmneziaWG to 3.1.20260814 (Windows) and 3.1.20260828 (macOS/Linux).
- ctrld to 1.5.9.
- cURL to 8.23.0.
- OpenSSL to 4.0.3.
- OpenVPN to 2.7.7.
- OpenVPN DCO driver to 2.8.7 on Windows.
- Third-party components from vcpkg to the latest versions for stability and security.
- Minimum macOS version to 14.4.
